steps.description:
- You will have to **push the log into the water, and use it to jump to a small island**.
- You will have to **keep moving until you see a fallen tree and wait for the spider to approach**.
- When this spider touches the tree, it will lift up, hence it will allow you to **make a jump to the higher ledge**.

1. Next, you will have to **push the tree stump over, and then jump across the gap**.
2. When you see a boulder, you have to **break the stick that is holding it in its position, then run to the left**.
3. You have to **take cover just below the ramp** and then the boulder will eventually smash the spider down into the abyss below.
4. You have to then **get close enough to the injured spider so it will try to stab you**.
5. **Move away quickly** so then it doesn’t.
6. Then **pull on its remaining leg** so it will come off its body.
7. Then **roll it into the spike pit to the right**.
